ceiling_directive: Complete the analytic node-weight characterization with a global dual certificate, identify all optimal designs, and derive the exact small-budget leading constant rather than only its exponent.
improvement_directive: Resolve the analytic-node-weight frontier by proving necessary-and-sufficient active-block conditions and a node-global dual certificate; use them to determine the exact optimizer and leading small-budget constant, including the Chebyshev-Lobatto win/loss/tie regimes.
critique: The note proves an exact worst-case variance calculation and an attained design minimum only within polynomial-exact linear readouts and its newly constructed aggregate-coefficient ellipsoid, not a minimax result over all estimators or the published CEY class. The headline term "saddle" overstates the theorem: it establishes a min-sup support calculation with a design-dependent leading-eigenvector adversary, but no max-min equality or common least-favourable schedule forming a saddle point. The small-budget result sharply identifies the exponent for fixed n, beta, k, B, and omega, but the lower and upper constants do not match and neither the optimal nodes nor the exact leading constant is determined. Since common-uniform monotone Bernoulli rollouts already appear in the published setup, the substantive advance is the exact covariance reduction and robust optimization on the note's own ellipsoid; the Chebyshev interval is only a routine consequence of that certificate.
